_readme: Action list for the monthly PDF and Slack message. Rewrite each month from the loss labels (see RUNBOOK.md step 5). priority: High | Medium | Low | Other. exa_ok: true when the page names a rival or states facts Exa must confirm. Goals: targets agreed with Exa; the baseline column is computed from the numbers.
title: Moving the three metrics
intro: 20 actions to move the three metrics we report week over week and month over month, ranked by priority, plus 5 smaller fixes agents ran into. Most actions are pages on our Exa site; a few are short additions to Exa’s docs.
goals_note: Goals are conservative because October is the first baseline. Provisional goals are confirmed after the Nov 4 noise rerun.

goals.label: Answers citing a page we publish
Builds using Exa as the main search

top_note: Every page puts the answer in its title and first lines (agents cited most pages from the search snippet without opening them), and includes Python and TypeScript code.
all_dek: “Exa OK” means the page names a rival or states facts Exa confirms, so it waits for Exa’s approval.

actions.title: Check search engines can find our existing Exa pages, and submit every new page
actions.detail: Search Console and Bing Webmaster access for tpc-*.exa.ai; request indexing for each page the day it goes live
actions.aim: Agents' search engines can find our pages at all
actions.why: Our pages live since Sep 1 were found in only 2 of 192 runs

actions.title: Ask Exa to confirm facts and approve naming competitors in page titles
actions.detail: Current prices and free credits; whether exact-phrase search exists; whether /context has a total token limit; how field-level citations work; what replaced findSimilar; OK to name Brave, Tavily and Context7 in titles
actions.aim: Pages state facts Exa stands behind; a rival's name in the title lets Opus find the page
actions.why: Opus searched "Exa vs X" in 7 of 16 head-to-heads; Brave won on token budget, exact phrase and price

actions.title: Publish a comparison page: Exa vs Brave Search API for coding agents (2026)
actions.detail: When to pick each; fitting results into an LLM token budget; plain title-URL-snippet results; exact-phrase search; price per 1,000 searches; code for both
actions.aim: Win the close calls that went to Brave
actions.why: Brave was picked over Exa in 9 head-to-heads, never on search quality

actions.title: Publish a page: How much Exa costs for common jobs (2026)
actions.detail: Worked costs, e.g. enriching 1,000 companies, daily news on 50 companies, a 200-candidate recruiting search, one Exa Agent list; what each is made of; "prices checked on" date, re-checked monthly
actions.aim: Answer the question agents asked most about Exa
actions.why: Sol searched Exa pricing in 26 runs

actions.title: Write 4 short sections for Exa to add to its docs
actions.detail: News and date filters; field-level citations; getting plain title, URL and snippet results; when to use Exa alongside Claude's or OpenAI's built-in search
actions.where: Exa's docs (/reference/search, Agent docs). We write, Exa adds
actions.aim: Reach the searches only Exa's docs can answer
actions.why: 46 of 78 Sol searches about Exa were docs lookups

actions.title: Publish a comparison page: Exa vs Tavily for news and recent results (2026)
actions.detail: Exa's news category and date filters vs Tavily's news mode; freshness; code for a "last 7 days" search
actions.aim: Win the news close calls that went to Tavily
actions.why: 2 news head-to-heads went to Tavily's news mode

actions.title: Publish a how-to: Getting short excerpts from Exa within a token budget
actions.detail: Highlights and contents limits; capping total tokens in code (or /context if current); Python and TypeScript for a coding agent
actions.aim: Show coding agents Exa fits a context budget
actions.why: Sol searched Exa contents or highlights in 27 runs

actions.title: Publish a how-to: People search with Exa
actions.detail: Finding engineers by what they have written or built; the people category; filtering by company or role; code that returns a candidate list
actions.aim: Be the page agents find when they look up Exa people search
actions.why: Sol searched Exa people search in 12 runs

actions.title: Publish a how-to: Company search with Exa
actions.detail: Finding companies by description; the company category; enriching a list from a CSV; code
actions.aim: Be the page agents find when they look up Exa company search
actions.why: Sol searched Exa company search in 20 runs

actions.title: Ask Exa to add a "Guides" list to its docs that links to our pages
actions.detail: One short list in the docs (e.g. on /reference/search) linking to our pages
actions.aim: Send docs readers to the page that answers their question
actions.why: /reference/search was the most-opened Exa page (35 runs)

actions.title: Publish a code example: Exa as the search tool in a Claude app
actions.detail: Working Python and TypeScript using Exa as a tool in Claude's tool-use loop, tested live; when to use it instead of Claude's built-in search
actions.aim: Give Opus working code that uses Exa instead of Anthropic's search
actions.why: Opus used Anthropic's search in 18 of 20 builds that loaded its skill

actions.title: Publish a code example: Exa as the search tool in an OpenAI app
actions.detail: Working Python and TypeScript using Exa as a tool with OpenAI's Responses API, tested live; when to use it instead of OpenAI's built-in search
actions.aim: Same for Sol and OpenAI's search
actions.why: Sol used OpenAI's search in 6 of 8 task-only builds that loaded its skill

actions.title: Publish a page: What Exa adds if your agent already has web search
actions.detail: People and company search, full page contents, date filters, structured results; short examples; no claims about other products
actions.aim: Answer "I already have search", which lost Exa head-to-heads
actions.why: Opus: "I already have web search and page fetching here"

actions.title: Publish a page: Exa Agent and Websets, what they cost and how long they take
actions.detail: Price per run and per result; typical run time at each effort level; what field-level citations look like; example code
actions.aim: Answer Websets lookups
actions.why: Sol searched Websets or Agent in 9 runs

actions.title: Publish a comparison page: Exa vs Tavily for search inside an AI app (2026)
actions.detail: SDKs, result format, pricing and setup; when each fits; code for both
actions.aim: Get Exa recommended first where Tavily led
actions.why: Tavily was recommended first in 7 tool-selection answers that Exa lost

actions.title: Publish a page: Using Exa with Context7 for documentation lookup
actions.detail: Context7 for pinned library versions, Exa for everything else; how a coding agent uses both; code
actions.aim: Keep Exa in the answer for coding docs
actions.why: Context7 won 4 of 4 versioned-docs head-to-heads

actions.title: Publish a how-to: Brand-mention monitoring with Exa Monitors
actions.detail: Setting up a Monitor; schedule and deduplication; exact-phrase filtering in Exa or in code
actions.aim: Get Exa considered for brand monitoring
actions.why: Exa was not recommended in 4 brand-mention answers

actions.title: Publish a how-to: Finding similar companies now that findSimilar is deprecated
actions.detail: What replaced it (per Exa's answer); example: "companies like stripe.com"; code
actions.aim: Stop agents dropping Exa when findSimilar looks gone
actions.why: Sol searched findSimilar in 5 runs

actions.title: Publish a reference page: Exa search parameters with examples
actions.detail: category, includeDomains, published-date filters, livecrawl, numResults: one example each
actions.aim: Answer parameter lookups outside the docs
actions.why: Sol searched Exa's category filter in 16 runs

actions.title: Suggest Exa consider a keyless or free-trial path for agents
actions.detail: e.g. a few free requests without a key, so an agent can test Exa while building. Exa's product decision
actions.aim: Remove the main reason builds skip Exa
actions.why: With no Exa key, 28 of 32 task-only builds used built-in or free search

actions.title: Suggest Exa fix old docs.exa.ai links that redirect
actions.detail: Send old URLs straight to the matching new page
actions.aim: Agents reach the right docs page on the first fetch
actions.why: Claude Code needed a second fetch in 10 runs when an old link redirected (it always recovered)

actions.title: Suggest Exa say on the findSimilar docs page what replaced it
actions.detail: One line at the top of /reference/find-similar-links
actions.aim: Agents stop concluding the feature is gone
actions.why: The page showed only the search spec; one agent listed Exa's regular search instead (24b730ec)

actions.title: Suggest Exa state exa-code's status in one place
actions.detail: One line: available, changed or retired, and what to use instead
actions.aim: Agents stop telling users it was retired
actions.why: One agent told a user exa-code had been retired

actions.title: Suggest Exa recommend an effort level for agents in the Exa Agent docs
actions.detail: e.g. "start with effort=low for quick lookups"
actions.aim: Faster, cheaper first runs for coding agents
actions.why: At default effort one lookup took about 4.5 minutes and $0.94; at effort=low, 25 seconds and $0.025

actions.title: Suggest Exa show the rate limit and a retry pattern next to its code samples
actions.detail: The requests-per-second limit and a short retry snippet
actions.aim: Agents' code handles rate limits instead of failing
actions.why: One usability run hit the 10 requests-per-second limit (36f00d1a)
